audit_scope.task_scope: cell-state mapping and development-only RNA-conditioned ATAC

scbutterfly_local.corpus: No upstream checkpoint; exact outer-training same-cell or same-nucleus RNA-ATAC pairs only

interpretation: scButterfly has no upstream corpus contamination when trained locally, but its released high-level workflow is not leakage-safe: it preprocesses the full supplied RNA and ATAC objects before train/test IDs, requires both modalities, and runs bidirectional test loaders. RNA-conditioned ATAC is admissible only through a new frozen RNA-only adapter. Decoder values are continuous training-target scores; inverse TF-IDF is prohibited because it needs query-ATAC-derived library and frequency quantities. GSE289173 can seal cell-state mapping but cannot seal RNA-conditioned ATAC because it has no ATAC truth.
remaining_blockers: Implement a prepare/fit/predict adapter that fits HVGs, peaks, ATAC IDF/global scale, chromosome order, model state, and calibration on outer-training donors only and accepts RNA-only query tensors.

Bypass the high-level Butterfly.test_model bidirectional loader, force every module to eval mode, use no-grad inference, and prove adding, removing, or permuting query cells cannot change model state or another query prediction.
Ignore the upstream ATAC_data_var assignment from RNA_data.var and attach the independently frozen GRCh38.p14 peak table; test exact peak order and chromosome counts.

Define the primary profile endpoint on direct continuous decoder scores. Do not use inverse TF-IDF counts, predicted fragments, or calibrated accessibility probabilities unless a training-only calibration is prespecified and validated.
Validate same-nucleus joins for GSE296875. Reject GSE244832 different-aliquot rows as pairs and restrict its profile evaluation to donor-by-cell-state aggregation.
Freeze scButterfly-B as the common architecture. Treat C/T/TC augmentation as separate native lanes and prove no held labels, ATAC, or cells enter augmentation.
Replace unrestricted torch.load with a project-controlled local state-dict loader and record exact hashes plus key/shape/dtype manifests.
Validate the legacy scvi-tools 0.19.0, SciPy 1.9.3, EpiScanpy 0.3.2, Torch, CUDA, BatchNorm, deterministic-seed, resume, and memory behavior on an approved L40S smoke job.
Prove GSE289173 receives only anonymized RNA after selection lock and cannot influence preprocessing, adaptation, head fitting, or calibration before prediction hashes are committed.
sealed_champion_eligibility: blocked_pending_frozen_rna_only_adapter_training_only_preprocessing_profile_scale_pairing_runtime_and_leakage_fixtures; eligible in principle for sealed cell-state mapping only
